row.evidence: LiveAgent's SSO (Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Okta, Duo) "does not create new users in the system, they still have to be manually created prior logging-in using SSO"; no SCIM appears on the pricing page or in the support centre.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). SSO moved down: the pricing page now lists SSO on Medium business ($29/agent/mo annual) rather than Large; the SSO help article (May 2024) still says Large and Enterprise. Okta is OIDC via a custom app; Google/Microsoft/Facebook are social logins. Audit log starts on Large. LDAP plugin can import and authenticate agents. API v3 (API key, 180 req/min) included on every plan; it can list, delete and undelete agents but has no create-agent call in the published spec.

plans.name: Medium business
plans.notes: Pricing card lists SSO here; the SSO help article says Large and Enterprise (see conflicts).

plans.name: Large business
plans.notes: Audit log (UI plugin) starts here; no audit-log API documented.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented on the pricing page, support-centre sitemap (587 articles), features pages or API spec; left null (none by absence).

limitations.text: SSO does not create users; agents must be created manually before signing in with SSO.

user_api.notes: Full v3 reference is per account (YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3); endpoints here are from the OpenAPI spec published on LiveAgent's own support.ladesk.com tenant.

capabilities.notes: reactivate_user = undelete of a deleted agent.

endpoints.purpose: Is the agent in the department

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log is a UI plugin (Configuration>System>Tools>Audit log); no API endpoint found in the spec.

rate_limits.text: 180 requests per minute per API key (cloud accounts).

limitations.text: No create-agent endpoint in the published v3 spec.

okta.notes: No LiveAgent page in the Okta Integration Network (okta.com/integrations/liveagent returns 404); LiveAgent documents Okta OIDC SSO via a custom app integration.

entra.notes: No LiveAgent entry in the Microsoft Learn saas-apps index; LiveAgent offers "Microsoft" login (social-style, not tenant SAML).

jumpcloud.notes: Not found in the JumpCloud support sitemap.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP plugin: import agents from an LDAP directory and authenticate them with LDAP credentials
